role: RR-interval artifact detector: classifies every beat against a rolling median of its neighbourhood as technical (out of range), extra, missed, ectopic or clean, and computes the artifact percentage of a window; also declares the sorted-[Double] binary-search helpers shared with WindowSelector.
types: ArtifactDetector.Config: struct — windowSize (HRVConstants.Artifacts.windowSize = 50), ectopic 0.20 (both sides), missed 0.50 (long side), extra 0.50 (short side), minRR/maxRR
Array where Element == Double: extension — sortedInsertionIndex/sortedFirstIndex binary searches
toplevel: Config default values: ectopicThreshold 0.20, missedThreshold 0.50, extraThreshold 0.50, windowSize/minRR/maxRR from HRVConstants. The rolling median is taken over the in-range beats only (referenceMedians), so technical artifacts do not shift the median used to judge neighbouring beats.

units.does: Returns one ArtifactFlags per RR point: takes each beat's reference median from referenceMedians (rolling median over the in-range beats) and classifies the beat against it; [] for an empty series.

branches.cond: map over every point index (none for an empty series)

units.does: True when rrMs is within [config.minRR, config.maxRR].

Per beat, the rolling median (computeRollingMedian over config.windowSize) of the in-range beats only, mapped back to each in-range beat's index; out-of-range beats get 0, which classify never reads because it rejects them first.

branches.effect: only in-range beats enter the median
writes each one's median at its original index

units.does: Classifies one beat (confidence always 1.0 — every band is a hard threshold): out of [minRR,maxRR] → technical; shorter than median×(1−extraThreshold) (0.5) → extra; longer than median×(1+missedThreshold) (1.5) → missed; any other deviation > ectopicThreshold (0.20) on either side → ectopic; else clean.

flags.text: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's artifact table still describes a 0.30 'outer short gate' (extraThreshold 0.30) with the short ectopic decision below 0.7×median, and a 'ratio / threshold' confidence; the code flags short ectopics from 0.8×median down to 0.5×median (symmetric with the long side), extraThreshold is 0.50, and every flag's confidence is 1.0. docs/API_REFERENCE.md lists extraThreshold 0.30.

units.does: Percentage (0-100) of flags marked isArtifact in the clamped half-open window [start,end).

flags.text: ImportDataView.assembleResult recomputes the window artifact percentage inline instead of calling artifactPercentage, without the index clamping or the empty-window guard (divides by windowEnd - windowStart).

units.does: Rolling median per index using an insertion-sorted window centred on i: the value itself plus windowSize/2 values on each side (51 for the default 50), truncated at the edges.

branches.cond: bootstrap loop over the first min(count, halfWindow+1) values
branches.effect: each inserted into sorted at its binary-search index
slide window and append median; if count == 1 the range 1..<1 is empty and only the bootstrap median is returned

flags.text: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md says a 'centered 50-beat sliding window'; with windowSize 50, halfWindow = 25 on each side plus the beat itself gives a 51-beat window (and the median includes the beat being judged).

units.does: Slides the sorted window to position i: inserts values[i+halfWindow] when in range, removes one copy of values[i-halfWindow-1] when it exists.

branches.effect: insert the entering value; else nothing enters (right edge)

branches.cond: oldLeft >= 0 and the value is found in sorted
branches.effect: remove it; else nothing removed (left edge, or not found — which cannot happen since every leaving value was inserted earlier)

units.does: Median of a sorted array: mean of the two middle elements for even count, middle element for odd.

branches.effect: average of sorted[mid-1] and sorted[mid] (for empty input this would index -1 and crash, but callers never pass empty); else sorted[mid]

units.does: Binary search: lower-bound index at which value inserts keeping the ascending array sorted.

branches.effect: keep halving; exits with lo = first index whose element >= value

units.does: Index of the first element exactly equal to value, nil when absent (uses sortedInsertionIndex).

branches.cond: lo out of bounds or element != value
